qa_pairs.question: What kind of information does the "Application utilisé compte GPUEN.png" graph present within the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The "Application utilisé compte GPUEN.png" graph in the Metrix portal displays the software that is most frequently used by a group specifically for their GPU accounts.

qa_pairs.question: Where can Alliance users find statistics on the most frequently used software for GPU accounts within the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Alliance users can find statistics on the most frequently used software for GPU accounts in the Metrix portal under the "GPU accounts" subsection, which is part of the "Account statistics" section. This information is shown in a graph titled "Application utilisé compte GPUEN.png."
